headline: Ben Duckett
body: Rockets stay top of Hundred table as Duckett stars. Another fine half-century from Ben Duckett and crucial late wickets from Mohammad Amir helped Trent Rockets deservedly stay top of The Hundred table with a five-run win over SunRisers Leeds, completing a home double at Trent Bridge.
